scope: Five main dirty precursor E2E files against current candidate overlay; source read-only.

blocking_findings.missing: After409, explicit visibility of resultText and basisText is replaced only by data-submission-id count.
blocking_findings.why_not_equivalent: Correct id permits blank/hidden rendered Result or Basis; exact display retention is a separate UI behavior.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep current id and fence checks; restore explicit Result/Basis visibility after conflict and after Keep input/use current version.

blocking_findings.missing: Fresh Send-preview confirmation message and unchanged composer draft, then Manual Preview on the still-suppressed target, were removed.
blocking_findings.why_not_equivalent: previewComment now proves no POST but not the instruction/draft; later manual preview occurs after unsuppression, a different state.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Restore message/draft checks, manual suppressed recheck, same before-state and zero-write assertions; retain centralized previewComment zero-POST observer.

blocking_findings.missing: Unchanged composer draft after fresh preview, explicit suppressed Manual Preview followup, and full comments.items equality replaced by IDs only.
blocking_findings.why_not_equivalent: Same comment IDs/execution graph can hide changed comment bodies; later confirmed Send does not cover Manual Preview under suppression.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Restore main draft/full-items/manual-preview assertions; retain candidate execution equality and suppressed checkbox checks.

blocking_findings.missing: Submitted identifier UUID-shape check removed when obtaining id from pending.delivery.current.
blocking_findings.why_not_equivalent: Response/GET equal identifiers alone can both have malformed shape.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Apply original /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i to candidate submission.id in each case without replacing stronger exact delivery checks.

blocking_findings.missing: Completion form dismissal assertion after successful exact acceptance.
blocking_findings.why_not_equivalent: Reopen button visibility/API completion does not strictly assert old form removal.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Restore await expect(completion).toHaveCount(0) after completion response while keeping receipt/final delivery checks.

accepted_candidate_improvements: Boundary renderedActions includeHidden covers unauthorized hidden controls; preserve it.
Boundary optional source_structure buttons follow actual capability contract.
Candidate actual submission/acceptance receipts, immutable delivery identity/fences and exact final decision checks are stronger and should remain.
Shared helper leaveThroughUI retains actual HTTP/UI participant departure with current delivery unchanged.
Candidate preview execution-state equality and zero-comment-POST watcher are useful additions.
required_followup: Author restores missing controls; independent focused recheck plus newly numbered affected directed tests before seven-file commit. Current viewport17 pass predates this preservation repair.
